mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ainote_note_like (id, note_id, user_id, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, sys_org_code, tenant_id) VALUES (#{id}, #{noteId}, #{userId}, #{createBy}, NOW(), #{createBy}, NOW(), #{sysOrgCode}, #{tenantId})
mapper.select: SELECT n.id, n.student_id AS studentId, n.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, n.chapter_id AS chapterId, ch.chapter_name AS chapterName, n.teaching_id AS teachingId, n.note_title AS noteTitle, n.note_content AS noteContent, n.rendered_content AS renderedContent, n.ai_summary AS aiSummary, n.keywords, n.current_version AS currentVersion, n.note_status AS noteStatus, CASE n.note_status WHEN 1 THEN '草稿' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' WHEN 3 THEN '已删除' ELSE '未知' END AS noteStatusText, n.is_public AS isPublic, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.like_count AS likeCount, n.create_by AS createBy, u.realname AS createByName, n.create_time AS createTime, n.update_by AS updateBy, n.update_time AS updateTime, n.sys_org_code AS sysOrgCode, n.tenant_id AS tenantId FROM ainote_note n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.student_id LEFT JOIN ainote_course c ON c.id = n.course_id LEFT JOIN ainote_chapter ch ON ch.id = n.chapter_id WHERE n.id = #{id}

SELECT n.id, n.student_id AS studentId, n.course_id AS courseId, c.course_name AS courseName, n.chapter_id AS chapterId, n.note_title AS noteTitle, n.ai_summary AS aiSummary, n.keywords, n.current_version AS currentVersion, n.note_status AS noteStatus, CASE n.note_status WHEN 1 THEN '草稿' WHEN 2 THEN '已完成' WHEN 3 THEN '已删除' ELSE '未知' END AS noteStatusText, n.is_public AS isPublic, n.view_count AS viewCount, n.like_count AS likeCount, n.create_by AS createBy, u.realname AS createByName, n.create_time AS createTime, n.update_time AS updateTime FROM ainote_note n LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = n.student_id LEFT JOIN ainote_course c ON c.id = n.course_id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
